visualCharacteristics: Asymmetric: first card ~2/3 width with large image and title below; next two cards stacked in the right 1/3 column, smaller image with title below

contentPattern.rows: 3 rows: row 1 is the large feature tile, rows 2-3 the smaller stacked tiles
cells: H3 title linked to the gallery page

usage: Promo collage at the top of a recipe topic page (e.g. Breakfast): one featured gallery beside two smaller gallery promos.
reuseGuidance: Use for exactly one feature tile plus two supporting tiles, each only an image and a linked H3 title. The first row is always the feature; for an even grid of image + title tiles use cards-gallery instead.
